---
title: "Decision Tree Analysis"
author: "Justin"
date: "2025-10-30"
output: html_document
---

```{r Decision_Tree_Model}
# ===================================================================
# ===== MODEL DECISION TREE (Latih:Uji:Validasi = 70:20:10) =====
# ===================================================================
# MAPPING:
# 70% (Latih) -> train_data
# 20% (Uji)   -> test_data
# 10% (Validasi) -> validation_data (Digunakan untuk tuning)
# ===================================================================

# -------------------------------
# 0. Load Library
# -------------------------------
packages <- c("rpart", "rpart.plot", "ggplot2", "pROC", "caret", "dplyr", "tikzDevice")
cat("Mengecek dan menginstall paket yang dibutuhkan...\n")
for(pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    cat(sprintf("Paket '%s' tidak ditemukan. Menginstall...\n", pkg))
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}
cat("Semua paket berhasil di-load.\n\n")

set.seed(123) # reproduksibilitas

# -------------------------------
# 1. LOAD DATA DARI SKRIP REGRESI LOGISTIK
# -------------------------------
if(file.exists("Data_Skripsi_Fixed_8vars.RData")) {
  load("Data_Skripsi_Fixed_8vars.RData")
  cat("SUKSES: Data berhasil dimuat dari 'Data_Skripsi_Fixed_8vars.RData'.\n")
  cat("Menerapkan proporsi: Latih (70%), Uji (20%), Validasi (10%)\n")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: File 'Data_Skripsi_Fixed_8vars.RData' tidak ditemukan. \nSilakan jalankan Chunk Regresi Logistik terlebih dahulu untuk membuat file ini.")
}

# --- PENTING: Hapus Variabel x9 (Duplikat x5) ---
# Agar konsisten dengan Regresi Logistik dan Pohon lebih bersih.
if("x9" %in% colnames(data_train_asli)) {
  data_train_asli$x9 <- NULL
  data_test_asli$x9  <- NULL
  data_val_asli$x9   <- NULL
  cat("SUKSES: Variabel x9 telah dihapus dari dataset Decision Tree.\n")
}

train_data      <- train_data_logreg # 70%
test_data       <- test_data_logreg  # 20%
validation_data <- val_data_logreg   # 10%

cat(sprintf("Data Latih (Train) : %d baris (70%%)\n", nrow(train_data)))
cat(sprintf("Data Uji (Test)    : %d baris (20%%)\n", nrow(test_data)))
cat(sprintf("Data Validasi (Val): %d baris (10%%)\n", nrow(validation_data)))


# -------------------------------
# 2. Pastikan Target Adalah Faktor
# -------------------------------
levels_y <- sort(unique(train_data$y)) 
cat("Levels Target:", paste(levels_y, collapse=", "), "\n")

train_data$y      <- factor(train_data$y, levels = levels_y)
validation_data$y <- factor(validation_data$y, levels = levels_y)
test_data$y       <- factor(test_data$y, levels = levels_y)


# LANGSUNG LANJUT KE BAGIAN 3 DI BAWAH INI
# ===================================================================

# -------------------------------
# 3. Grid Search Hyperparameter Decision Tree (3 Parameter)
# -------------------------------

# Menentukan rentang nilai parameter
minsplit_values  <- c(50, 100, 150)
minbucket_values <- c(25, 50, 75)
maxdepth_values  <- c(3, 4, 5)

# Siapkan dataframe untuk menyimpan hasil
results_df <- data.frame(
  minsplit = integer(),
  minbucket = integer(),
  maxdepth = integer(),
  Accuracy = double(),
  Precision = double(),
  Recall = double(),
  F1 = double()
)

cat("\nMemulai Grid Search (minsplit, minbucket, maxdepth)...\n")
cat("Note: Kombinasi di mana minsplit < 2 * minbucket akan dilewati (tidak valid).\n\n")

# Loop 3 Tingkat
for(ms in minsplit_values){
  for(mb in minbucket_values){
    
    # --- LOGIC CHECK ---
    # Syarat split: Induk harus punya minimal 'ms' data.
    # Syarat daun:  Anak harus punya minimal 'mb' data.
    # Jika ms < 2 * mb, maka split tidak mungkin terjadi secara logika matematika.
    # (Contoh: minsplit=50, minbucket=50 -> Tidak bisa membagi 50 menjadi 50 & 50)
    if(ms < 2 * mb) {
      next # Lewati kombinasi ini
    }
    
    for(md in maxdepth_values){
      
      # Train pada data training
      dt_model <- rpart(y ~ ., data=train_data, method="class",
                        control = rpart.control(minsplit = ms, 
                                                minbucket = mb, 
                                                maxdepth = md, 
                                                cp = 0))
      
      # Prediksi pada data validasi (Tuning)
      pred_val <- factor(predict(dt_model, newdata=validation_data, type="class"), levels=levels_y)
      
      # Hitung Metrik
      cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_val, validation_data$y, positive=as.character(levels_y[2]))
      
      acc  <- ifelse(is.na(cm$overall["Accuracy"]), 0, cm$overall["Accuracy"])
      prec <- ifelse(is.na(cm$byClass["Precision"]), 0, cm$byClass["Precision"])
      rec  <- ifelse(is.na(cm$byClass["Recall"]), 0, cm$byClass["Recall"])
      f1   <- ifelse(is.na(cm$byClass["F1"]), 0, cm$byClass["F1"])

      # Simpan Hasil
      results_df <- rbind(results_df, data.frame(
        minsplit = ms,
        minbucket = mb,
        maxdepth = md,
        Accuracy = round(acc, 4),
        Precision = round(prec, 4),
        Recall = round(rec, 4),
        F1 = round(f1, 4)
      ))
    }
  }
}
cat("Grid Search Selesai!\n\n")

# Urutkan berdasarkan F1 Score lalu Accuracy
results_df <- results_df[order(-results_df$F1, -results_df$Accuracy), ]
print("Hasil Grid Search (Top 5 Kombinasi):")
print(head(results_df, 5))

# Ambil parameter terbaik
best_params <- results_df[1, ]
cat(sprintf("\nKombinasi Terbaik:\nminsplit=%d, minbucket=%d, maxdepth=%d\nF1=%.4f, Accuracy=%.4f\n",
            best_params$minsplit, best_params$minbucket, best_params$maxdepth, 
            best_params$F1, best_params$Accuracy))

# -------------------------------
# 4. Latih Model Terbaik (Final Model)
# -------------------------------
cat("\nMelatih model terbaik menggunakan parameter optimal...\n")
best_model <- rpart(y ~ ., data=train_data, method="class",
                    control = rpart.control(minsplit = best_params$minsplit, 
                                            minbucket = best_params$minbucket,
                                            maxdepth = best_params$maxdepth, 
                                            cp = 0))


# ===================================================================
# ===== FUNGSI EVALUASI (TETAP SAMA) =====
# ===================================================================
# ... (Bagian fungsi evaluate_model_dt tidak perlu diubah, gunakan kode sebelumnya) ...

# -------------------------------
# 5. Eksekusi Evaluasi Model Terbaik
# -------------------------------
evaluate_model_dt(best_model, train_data, "Train")
evaluate_model_dt(best_model, validation_data, "Validation") 
evaluate_model_dt(best_model, test_data, "Test")             

# -------------------------------
# 6. Visualisasi Pohon Keputusan (PNG, PDF, LaTeX)
# -------------------------------
cat("\n--- Visualisasi Pohon Keputusan ---\n")

# Update judul agar mencakup minbucket
plot_title <- sprintf("Pohon Keputusan (split=%d, bucket=%d, depth=%d)", 
                      best_params$minsplit, best_params$minbucket, best_params$maxdepth)

# Simpan PNG
png("Decision_Tree_Plot.png", width=1200, height=800, res=100)
rpart.plot(best_model, main = plot_title, box.palette = "Blues", shadow.col = "grey", 
           roundint = FALSE, yesno = 2, extra = 1, type=2) 
dev.off()

# Simpan PDF
pdf("Decision_Tree_Plot.pdf", width=12, height=8)
rpart.plot(best_model, main = plot_title, box.palette = "Blues", shadow.col = "grey", 
           roundint = FALSE, yesno = 2, extra = 1, type=2) 
dev.off()

# Simpan TeX (TikZ)
cat("Menyimpan plot pohon keputusan sebagai 'Decision_Tree_Plot.tex'...\n")
tryCatch({
  tikz(file = "Decision_Tree_Plot.tex", width = 10, height = 7.5, verbose = FALSE)
  rpart.plot(best_model, main = plot_title, box.palette = "Blues", shadow.col = "grey", 
             roundint = FALSE, yesno = 2, extra = 1, type=2) 
  dev.off()
  cat("Plot .tex (TikZ) berhasil disimpan.\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  message("ERROR: Gagal menyimpan Decision Tree sebagai TikZ.")
  message(e)
  if(names(dev.cur()) == "tikz output") { dev.off() }
})

cat("Semua proses Decision Tree selesai.\n")
```
